title: Paranormal activity in towns after nuclear explosions

tellings.quote: in the towns after the explosions you have people report Devils chasing them around and all sorts of Paranormal Activity

So you talk about Trinity, and you talk about Roswell, and similar things happen in the towns after the explosions. You have people report devils chasing them around and all sorts of paranormal activity.
tellings.difference: Names Roswell as well as Trinity.
tellings.link_reason: Both say people in the towns reported devils chasing them and other paranormal activity after the explosions, in almost the same words.

as_told.title: Paranormal activity in towns after Trinity and Roswell
as_told.place_text: Trinity site and Roswell, New Mexico

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the New Mexico towns near the first nuclear explosions, starting in 1945, people reported devils chasing them and all sorts of other strange, ghostly happenings. He raises it while talking with the UFO researcher Jacques Vallee, as a hint that nuclear blasts and strange phenomena may be linked.
